haberler.baslik: JBS, Barclays targeted for alleged AML violations
haberler.ozet: A group of civil society organisations has accused the meat company of handling proceeds connected to illegal deforestation in the Amazon. Lenders Barclays and Standard Chartered, auditors KPMG and EY, Dutch law firm Loyens & Loeff and asset manager BlackRock have been accused of related anti-money laundering failures.

Borç verenler Barclays ve Standard Chartered, denetim firmaları KPMG ve EY, Hollanda hukuk firması Loyens & Loeff ve varlık yöneticisi BlackRock ilgili anti-kara para aklama başarısızlıklarıyla suçlandı.
